### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** ecf6509510f09ab85f6dc2cb43b1f287fc4fcd09 (origin/main 7f16f682d8)
* **Files:** plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-design-md-lint.sh ; gate plugins/dso/scripts/check-gate-tier-headers.sh ; .pre-commit-config.yaml gate-tier-headers-check

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (pre-existing; autonomous discovery)

#### Expected Behavior
Every hook under plugins/dso/hooks/ annotated '# hook-boundary: enforcement' must also declare '# DSO-GATE-TIER: A|B|C|N/A' (HOOKS-REFERENCE.md gate-tier doctrine), enforced by check-gate-tier-headers.sh.

#### Actual Behavior
pre-commit-design-md-lint.sh has '# hook-boundary: enforcement' (line 2) but NO '# DSO-GATE-TIER:' header (confirmed absent on origin/main). The gate-tier-headers-check pre-commit hook is files: ^plugins/dso/hooks/.*\.sh$ with pass_filenames:false, so it scans ALL enforcement hooks whenever ANY hooks/ file is staged. Result: every commit that touches plugins/dso/hooks/ is BLOCKED with 'pre-commit-design-md-lint.sh missing tier declaration'. Dormant until a hooks/ file is committed.

Repro: stage any plugins/dso/hooks/**/*.sh and commit -> gate-tier-headers-check fails.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
Blocks landing the Finding #3 sentinel fail-closed change (item 1). Recommended fix: add '# DSO-GATE-TIER: A' — the hook propagates design-md-lint.sh's exit code to BLOCK commits (fails closed), matching its Tier-A pre-commit siblings (review-gate, test-gate, enforcement-boundary-check). Owner should confirm A vs B (B if it is intended as a non-blocking style hint, which would also mean the 'enforcement' boundary annotation is wrong). Shared CI/PR-domain safeguard file.
data.title: [pre-commit-design-md-lint.sh]: enforcement-annotated hook missing DSO-GATE-TIER header -> blocks all hooks/ commits
